title: 第 十三章 陆引弘之死第 十四章 商量
slug: 残鼎复元陆家修仙崛起路
content_zh:
陆引弘带着陆行夕离开流云仙城后，一路上二人皆是小心谨慎。
他们并未选择来时的那条路返回青云坊市。
而是特意绕开流云山脉，取道平阳郡的铜陵县，迂回向青云坊市行进。
陆引弘之所以如此谨慎行事，便是担忧其他家族察觉端倪，从而对他们不利。
在青云坊市陆家的商铺周围，已然多了许多陌生面孔。
这些人看似随意，却在有意无意地打听陆家那些丹药的出处。
陆引弘二人途经铜陵县，进入了一处密林中。
只要穿过这片密林，便能抵达青云坊市。
陆引弘将神识外放，仔细察看着林中的每一处角落。
突然，他眉头猛地一皱，敏锐的察觉到了异常。
前方不远处，竟隐藏着几股不弱的气息，正鬼鬼祟祟的朝着他们悄然靠近。
陆引弘立刻压低声音，对陆行夕说道：“小心，有埋伏！”
说罢，他急忙带着陆行夕掉头往回走。
然而，只见来时的路瞬间被一片浓雾所笼罩，什么都看不清了。
陆引弘无奈，只能停下脚步，迅速从储物袋中掏出一张金刚符。
他将金刚符朝着身前用力一抛，注入其中。
刹那间，金刚符光芒大放，化作一层坚固的金色护罩，将陆引弘和陆行夕稳稳的护在里面。
“你们好大的胆子，竟敢袭杀陆家之人，就不怕陆家的报复吗？”
陆引弘大声呵斥道，声音在密林中回荡。
他的话音刚落，六名黑衣人窜了出来，将他们团团围住。

陆引弘目光一扫，看清来人修为，其中两名炼气七层，四名炼气六层，心中顿时暗叫不妙。
但他面上依旧强作镇定，没有露出丝毫惧色。
为首之人冷笑一声，讥讽道：“陆道友，你就别白费力气吓唬我们了。”
“就陆家那点能耐，若不是背靠夏家这棵大树，你觉得还能在修仙界立足？”
陆引弘冷哼一声，心中明白这群人根本没将陆家放在眼里。
“几位道友，不知为何拦住我俩的去路？若是求财，我们愿意将储物袋拱手奉上。”陆引弘无奈说道。
形势比人强，他也只能出此下策。
“哈哈，陆道友莫不是第一天在这修仙界行走，竟如此天真。”
“跟我们走一趟吧，或许还能留你一条活路。”为首的黑衣人戏谑的笑道。
陆引弘眉头紧锁，从这人的话语中不难听出，这群人显然是受人指使，根本不在乎劫财与否。
他冷笑一声，暗中传音给陆行夕。
“行夕，我拖住他们，你待会寻到机会就赶紧跑，记住，就算跑不掉，也绝不能让他们知晓行舟的存在。”
说完，他迅速往陆行夕手中塞入一张土遁符和一些丹药。
“三叔，您别管我，您自己赶紧离开！”陆行夕神情严肃，焦急的说道。
“行夕，现在不是谦让的时候，你留下非但起不到作用，还会白白送命。”
“我修为比你高，能多拖住他们一些时间，要是你能回到家族，记得告诉族里的人，不要着急联系行舟。”
陆引弘说完，立刻拿出一把灵剑，输入灵力，剑身上顿时光芒大盛。
他操控着灵剑，朝着这群人中修为最低的一名修士疾冲而去。
那名黑衣人见状，急忙运转灵力，给自己加持了一层土黄色的光幕，形成一个防御保护罩。
陆引弘的攻击狠狠砸在光幕上，光幕瞬间破碎，不过他的攻击威力也因此减弱了许多，被黑衣人轻易挡了下来。

与此同时，两侧的黑衣人见他出手，也同时发难，纷纷祭出法器，朝着陆引弘攻去。
content_en:
After Lu Yinhong took Lu Xingxi away from Liuyun Fairy City, they were both cautious along the way.
They did not choose the way back to Qingyunfang City.
Instead, they deliberately bypassed the Liuyun Mountains, passed through Tongling County in Pingyang County, and headed towards Qingyunfang City in a roundabout way.
The reason why Lu Yinhong acted so cautiously was because he was worried that other families would notice the clues and harm them.
There are already many unfamiliar faces around the Lu family's shop in Qingyunfang City.
These people seemed casual, but they were intentionally or unintentionally inquiring about the origin of the Lu family's pills.
Lu Yinhong and his two men passed through Tongling County and entered a dense forest.
As long as you pass through this dense forest, you can reach Qingyunfang City.
Lu Yinhong released his consciousness and carefully inspected every corner of the forest.
Suddenly, his brows furrowed sharply, and he was keenly aware of the abnormality.
Not far ahead, there were actually several strong auras hiding, sneaking towards them quietly.
Lu Yinhong immediately lowered his voice and said to Lu Xingxi, "Be careful, there is an ambush!"
After saying that, he hurriedly took Lu Xingxi and turned around and walked back.
However, the road they came from was instantly shrouded in thick fog, making it impossible to see anything clearly.
Lu Yinhong had no choice but to stop and quickly took out a diamond talisman from his storage bag.
He threw the Vajra Talisman in front of him and poured it into it.
In an instant, the diamond talisman glowed brightly and turned into a solid golden shield, firmly protecting Lu Yinhong and Lu Xingxi inside.
"You are so brave, you dare to attack and kill people from the Lu family, aren't you afraid of the Lu family's revenge?"
Lu Yinhong shouted loudly, his voice echoing in the dense forest.
As soon as he finished speaking, six men in black rushed out and surrounded them.
Lu Yinhong glanced around and saw clearly the cultivation levels of the people coming. Two of them were at the seventh level of Qi Refining and four were at the sixth level of Qi Refining. He suddenly screamed in his heart that something was not good.
But he still maintained a composure on his face, without showing the slightest hint of fear.
The leader sneered and said sarcastically: "Friend Lu Dao, please don't waste your efforts to scare us."
"With the Lu family's ability, if it weren't for the big tree of the Xia family, do you think we could still be able to gain a foothold in the world of immortality?"
Lu Yinhong snorted coldly, knowing in his heart that these people did not take the Lu family seriously at all.
"A few fellow Taoists, why are we blocking our way? If you are asking for money, we are willing to hand over the storage bag." Lu Yinhong said helplessly.
The situation was stronger than the people, so he could only make this last resort.
"Haha, could it be that Fellow Daoist Lu was so naive on his first day walking in this world of immortality?"
"Come with us, maybe we can give you a way to survive." The leader of the men in black said with a joking smile.
Lu Yinhong frowned. From this man's words, it was not difficult to tell that this group of people were obviously ordered by others and did not care whether they robbed money or not.
He sneered and secretly sent the message to Lu Xingxi.
"Xingxi, I'll hold them back. You can run away when you find the opportunity later. Remember, even if you can't run away, you must never let them know about Xingzhou's existence."
After saying that, he quickly stuffed an Earth Escape Talisman and some pills into Lu Xingxi's hand.
"Third uncle, please leave me alone and leave quickly!" Lu Xingxi said anxiously with a serious expression.
"Xing Xi, now is not the time to be humble. Not only will your stay be ineffective, but you will also lose your life in vain."
"My cultivation level is higher than yours, so I can hold them back for a little longer. If you can return to the clan, remember to tell the clan members not to contact Xingzhou in a hurry."
After Lu Yinhong finished speaking, he immediately took out a spiritual sword and input spiritual power, and the sword suddenly glowed brightly.
He controlled the spiritual sword and rushed towards the monk with the lowest cultivation level among the group of people.
Seeing this, the man in black hurriedly used his spiritual power to bless himself with a layer of earth-yellow light curtain, forming a protective shield.
Lu Yinhong's attack hit the light screen hard, and the light screen shattered instantly. However, the power of his attack was also weakened a lot, and he was lightly attacked by the man in black.Yi blocked it.
At the same time, when the men in black on both sides saw him taking action, they also took action at the same time. They all took out their magic weapons and attacked Lu Yinhong.
